protocol.status: DEV-only diagnostic; no holdout or universality claim
protocol.selection_information: trajectory topple labels and planned control family only; no monitor score
protocol.topple: peak block tilt >=45 degrees at any point in H8 plus hold30
protocol.fork: at least 2 of 64 probes upright and at least 2 toppled
protocol.probes: exact frozen Jenga 64xH8 xyz tracking-error snippets at 1x
protocol.trajectory: anonymous single-block pose and velocity padded with invariant rigid-body slots
protocol.monitor: frozen Regime Monitor v0 unchanged: candidate, 3 pairs, 5 bisections, commitment, persistence
